data.direction: A frightened child calling across a yard in the dark. Don't act a child's voice: speak naturally, scared and small, a little out of breath.
data.process: Made a child's size: a smaller throat (the formants moved up with the pitch), then a higher voice in it, a little open air. Nothing uncanny: a real survivor and a Soot Child must sound the same.

data.direction: Start like Children 02, then let the voice sag and stretch into a long, low breath out that doesn't stop when it should. This is the moment it turns.
data.process: The start made child-sized like the call; the end slowed, pitched down and torn apart so the child's voice turns into something else.

data.words: Yard to consist. / Manifest follows. / Gates open. / Yard out. / Yard clerk. / Consist received. / Tally follows. / Powder and shot. / Cars delivered. / Cars lost. / Child survivor. / Child survivors. / Body recovered. / Body not recovered. / Gunpowder and shot. / Machine parts. / Comet-derived material.
data.direction: A yard clerk reading off a clipboard into a radio at the end of a long shift. Flat, even, official. One phrase at a time with a breath between each; same pace throughout.
data.process: Cut word by word into the clerk's bank, made an older, flatter man's voice and crushed through the radio set, so it's the yard and not you. Replaces the text-to-speech clerk.

data.words: Zero. One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven. Eight. Nine. Ten. Eleven. Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Nineteen. Twenty. Thirty. Forty. Fifty. Sixty. Seventy. Eighty. Ninety. Hundred. Thousand. Million. Minus.
data.direction: The clerk's numbers. Each word on its own, a beat between them, the same flat tone, no rise at the end of the list.
data.process: Cut word by word into the clerk's bank, made an older, flatter man's voice and crushed through the radio set, so it's the yard and not you. Replaces the text-to-speech clerk.

data.words: Crew. Coal. Cars. Freight. Cargo. Paid. Fee. Refund. Mail. Salvage. Repairs. Net. Next. Goods. Grain. Livestock. Food. Chemicals. Ore. Medicine. Timber.

data.process: Cut word by word into the clerk's bank, made an older, flatter man's voice and crushed through the radio set, so it's the yard and not you. Replaces the text-to-speech clerk.

data.words: Consist derailed. / Took the. / Too fast. / Ran onto the washout. / Gave way under car. / The switchman threw the points under it. / They throw a train off. / Ran onto the sleepers. / They'll take. / The stoker ran away with it. / Nobody on the throttle. / Forward cannon crewed by. / Forward cannon not crewed. / No forward cannon on the consist. / Firebox last tended. / Nobody had tended the firebox. / Recovery not scheduled. / Cause not established. / Consist reported stranded. / Recovery at first light. / Recovery is chargeable. / Kilometres an hour. / From the train.
data.direction: The derailment's cause card and the stranded line. Same clerk, a shade more tired: this is paperwork about the dead.
data.process: Cut word by word into the clerk's bank, made an older, flatter man's voice and crushed through the radio set, so it's the yard and not you. Replaces the text-to-speech clerk.

data.words: At. The. Over. Bend. Throttle. Unattended. Kilometre. Seconds. Metres. Car. Mile. Fort. Junction. Tunnel. Wreck.

data.process: Cut word by word into the clerk's bank, made an older, flatter man's voice and crushed through the radio set, so it's the yard and not you. Replaces the text-to-speech clerk.

data.direction: Four sharp breaths in through the teeth, as if stepping out into freezing wind. A second between each.
data.process: Cleaned and levelled; a little pitch spread so each crewmate's breath differs. Breath carries no voice, so it stays close to what you did.

data.direction: Four long breaths out, slow, a misty hhhh. A second between each.
data.process: Cleaned and levelled, a little pitch spread between takes.

data.direction: 15 seconds of shivering: teeth chattering, shaky breaths, a low hum through closed lips now and then.
data.process: Made a seamless loop for as long as the cold has them.

data.direction: The Track Doll's giggle: small, breathy, delighted, as if watching someone play with your things. Four different giggles, a few seconds apart.
data.process: Pitched up into porcelain, thinned to the giggle's 3-6 kHz band so it cuts through the train, a little ring of a hollow head.

data.direction: The Choir's voices: long sustained notes, 10 seconds each, low and steady, no vibrato. Four different notes, some on 'ooo', some on 'mmm'.
data.process: Layered into dozens of voices that gather as the Choir does; detuned, spread and smeared until no single voice is yours.

data.direction: The dead channel laughing over the derailment's replay: slow and low, at a joke nobody else gets. About 10 seconds.
data.process: Slowed, detuned and passed through a dead radio, so it sounds like it's coming from a long way under the static.

data.direction: A long, low howl rising and falling, as a hound would across a valley. Four of them.
data.process: Dropped an octave, a bigger chest, roughened and layered with the packs' animal sounds; distance and night added.

data.direction: Four short snarls and growls from the back of the throat, close and threatening.
data.process: Pitched down and layered with the packs' growls; the human throat buried.

data.direction: The Grumbler going feral at whoever hit it: a guttural, ugly scream of rage. Two takes; don't hurt your voice.
data.process: Torn and doubled, gritty, a corrupted human under it.

data.direction: 15 seconds of wet chewing, smacking and muttering: bite an apple close to the phone.
data.process: Slowed and made wetter, set in a crate's wood, looped for as long as it eats.

data.direction: A long dying exhale that ends in a rattle. Three takes.
data.process: Pitched and layered per creature (the Gaunt, the Switchman, the Whistler, a Soot Child), so each death is its own.
